column3: Close to the Greek; the critical text adds “brethren,” which NKJV lacks with the Textus Receptus.
NKJV has the order “fish … birds,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “birds … fish.”
NKJV has “the second Man is the Lord from heaven,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the second man is from heaven.”
NKJV has “O Hades” and the order “sting … victory,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “O Death” twice, with “victory” first.
